messages.subject: Spatial model for Line data
parts:
Dears.

Nowadays, I am working on a problem which I cannot find a solution. I have a variable that represents a line over the space. How can I use this characteristic both to set up a spatial model and to deal with cross-sections? I would like to use INLA and SPDE approach. Is it possible?

Best regards!
